title: user.merged
description: Consumed from stapel-auth. An anonymous guest account was absorbed into an existing account; the guest row ceases to exist. Notifications carries the guest's feed history (NotificationLog) and registered devices (DevicePushToken) onto the survivor. UserNotificationSettings is one row per person: the survivor's preferences win and the guest's row is dropped, unless the survivor has none, in which case the guest's choices are carried over. UserContact is dropped rather than carried — it is a projection of auth, and the survivor's own contact sync is authoritative. Contract owned by the emitter.
